findings.issue: The masked-date DOM-correction path is gated on `formatted == Value`, which is false when `Value` is still null (never bound, or bound to a null initial value) and the typed text produced no digits. In that case a rejected character stays in the DOM unstyled and un-typed-over, i.e. exactly the defect the fix was meant to remove, just on the null-valued first keystroke. Example: `<WInput Type="WInputType.Date" />` with no @bind-Value, type 'a' -> formatted is "", Value is null, the branch is skipped, ValueChanged goes nowhere and 'a' sticks; typing 'b' next leaves "ab".
findings.fix: In OnDateInputAsync change the guard to compare against a non-null value: `if (formatted == (Value ?? string.Empty))`, leaving the rest of the branch (getSelectionStart / CaretForDigitCount / setInputValue) unchanged.

findings.issue: The «الكل» tab still passes the literal `Count="9"` while the same number is now the constant `Ar.AttentionCenter.TodayActionCount` used on the WSectionHeader one line above. This is the same constant-vs-markup drift the prior review's finding 4 raised about PendingExpensesCountBadge; it was fixed for the section header but re-introduced on the tab.
findings.fix: On the first WTabItem replace `Count="9"` with `Count="Ar.AttentionCenter.TodayActionCount"` so the header badge and the الكل tab cannot diverge.

findings.issue: Self-disclosed and confirmed: inserting a genuinely NEW digit in the middle of an already-complete date changes the formatted string, so Blazor's own re-render of the `value` attribute runs after the JS caret set and bounces the caret to the end of the field. Only the rejected-character case is fully fixed.
findings.fix: Store the computed caret in a field on every OnDateInputAsync (not only in the equal-string branch) and re-apply it from `OnAfterRenderAsync` via `wakeelUi.setInputValue`/a caret-only helper, so the correction happens after Blazor's diff rather than before it.

findings.issue: The moved-away `src/Wakeel.UI/wwwroot` folder is left behind on disk as an empty directory (git shows only the file deletions, so it is invisible in the diff). It is still emitted as ContentRoot index 8 of src/Wakeel.Desktop/bin/Debug/net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0/Wakeel.Desktop.staticwebassets.runtime.json, and the spec's rule was a clean move.
findings.fix: Delete the empty directory `src/Wakeel.UI/wwwroot` from the working tree; the next build drops the stale content root from the manifest.

findings.issue: Carried over from round 1 and still open: the W04 expectation isolates the lone digit «1» in «الجهاز 1» while the normative reference docs/design/bidi-test.html leaves it outside <bdi>. The code and the suite are internally consistent and correctly reverted per the supervisor's ruling, but the normative document still disagrees.
